This is a synthetic power system network model that covers the geographic
footprint of the state of Texas. The case is designed with a 345, 230, 138
and 69 kV transmission network to serve a load that roughly mimics the
actual population of its geographic footprint. The synthetic transmission
system was designed by algorithms described in [1] to be statistically
similar to actual transmission system models but without modeling any
One-line diagrams and other data formats available at:
This synthetic dateset was developed as part of the ARPA-E GRID DATA
program as part of the EPIGRIDS project.
When publishing results based on this data, please cite:

Ph.D. Thesis, The University of Wisconsin - Madison, 2021.
